meta.description: Furmeetgalilum furry maanaadugalilum puthiyavargal puthiya nanbargalai uruvaakkum idam. Global Furry Television vazhangugirathu.
site.name: GFTV HelloSpot
official.domain-heading: Athigaarappoorva GFTV thalangal globalfurry.tv allathu gftv.asia endru mudiyum
official.domain-body: Mugavariyai athan mudivilirunthu padiyungal: muthal otraich chaaivukkottukku mun ulla kadaisip pulliyaip paarungal. Veru ethilaavathu mudiyum thalam, mugavariyin munpaguthiyil anthap peyar irunthaalum, GFTV alla.
official.secure-body: Poottuk kuriyaiyo mugavariyin thodakkaththil https:// enbathaiyo paarungal. Paathugaappaana inaippin moolam athigaarappoorva thalaththil mattume thanippatta vivarangalaip pagirungal.
update.label: Puthuppippu
update.ready: GFTV HelloSpot-in puthiya pathippu thayaaraaga ullathu.
hero.card-alt: HelloSpot peyar attai. Periya punnagaiyin arugil Hello, 哈喽 endru ezhuthappattullathu, pinnaniyil GFTV-in vaanavil kodugal.
hero.title: Neengal oru HelloSpot-aik kandupidiththuvitteergal!
hero.lede: Furmeetgalilum furry maanaadugalilum, puthiyavargal puthiya nanbargalai uruvaakkum idame HelloSpot.
how.title: HelloSpot eppadich seyalpadugirathu
how.spot.title: Punnagaiyaik kandupidiyungal
how.spot.body: Attai, kazhuththuppattai allathu arivippup palagaiyil HelloSmile-aith thedungal. Athu enge irukkiratho, athuve HelloSpot.
how.hello.title: Vanakkam sollungal
how.hello.body: Arugil vanthu vanakkam sollungal. Neengal yaaraiyaavathu yerkenave therinthirukka vendum endru HelloSpot-il yaarum ethirpaarppathillai.
how.friend.title: Nanbarai uruvaakkungal
how.friend.body: Ungalaich sutriyullavargalaich santhiyungal; adutha santhippil thedip paarkka oruvarudan vidaiperungal.

about.title: Global Furry Television
about.body-1: Global Furry Television (GFTV) Singappoorai thalamaagak konda, Aasiyaavin migapperiya furry rasigar seythi alaivarisai.
about.body-2: Indrum naalaiyum anaivarum potrum vagaiyil furry-galin valarchchiyai naangal kaatchippaduththugirom; makkal oruvaraiyoruvar arinthu purinthukolla idangalaiyum amaikkirom.
about.body-3: Thaaymannilirunthu perungandangalaith thaandi virinthulla GFTV kuzhu pannaattu, palkalaachaara, panmozhik kuzhuvaagum.
